searchText: So I also updated those test vector PRs with removal of `beacon_state.ssz` and replace with smaller `block_roots.ssz`. Should be sufficient to rebuild proofs from. If that is all good for Trin, I think we can merge all 3 PRs? I also reactivated/updated the hive test vectors. But I did NOT test these within Hive (I did run the data in local tests). I remember these discussions before and still kinda like the list but will go ahead and make the change for ultralight. Do we need to coordinate this with a version bump or is this something we just do and lube with the breakage until historical summaries are consistently on the network? I would say it is something we just do as they are currently not being accepted anyhow (no historical summaries to verify). (Actually, fluffy already has this change in there since months). The list just gives you a false idea of future compatibility. You'd still have to adapt it to check the amount in the list. This isn't an issue for us as we do this already. Regardless, `StableContainer` is the real better solution Sure, but the point is that if there ever is another update, you have to add another limit & size check. So you might as well just have another vector type and be type safe about it. So the test vectors work for Trin and fluffy, and there seems to be general agreement on the specs PR. So if no other remarks/concerns, I will merge these PRs. 👍 from trin I also don't think this is something that needs coordinated rollout, because as Kim said, there are no historical summaries available to validate them at the moment, so no clients should be storing them. If some clients were storing them, I would say that they should purge them from their db.
